Role merge (2026-09-07): the Implementer sub-agent could not be spawned (account usage limit); the orchestrating agent implements directly per the user's 'Continue where you left off' directive. The Verifier cold-check must still run as a separate pass before closeout.

Implementation companion (design extension within the ratified scope): the materialize SKIP hands the synthesis stages their aggregates via a materialize-restore cache (.state/pdf-progress/<slug>.json) — runSynthesisStages consumes MaterializeResult, so skipping materialize without restoring would starve synthesis. The cache is written BEFORE the stage marker (a crash between them degrades to a conservative re-materialize); restoreMaterializeResult converges workingPageHashes from disk and deliberately sets writtenPages=[] (pages were rewritten by the CRASHED attempt, not this run — feeding them as rewrittenThisRun would force re-synthesis of every completed page, defeating the per-page skip law).

Resume-line wording refined during gating: the phase doc's draft 'Resuming <file> from chunk N/M (earlier chunks already extracted)...' names the FIRST SKIPPED chunk (1/M) even when chunks 1..K-1 are the done ones — misleading in the DAD_2025 shape. Implemented as the ratified refinement-round wording instead: 'Resuming <file> — N/M chunks already extracted, skipping...', emitted from a pre-loop scan using the SAME deterministic guard so the count is truthful; the redundant materialize-complete variant was removed (the pre-scan line always fires first when materialize-skip is possible).

Curation stage flag is recorded (stages.curation, set when materialize's curation pair ran) but curation has NO hard skip of its own on resume — the materialize-skip restores the curation summary from the cache, so zero curation calls fire on a hash-matching retry (asserted in gate 28.6). Soft-skip only, as the phase doc §2.2 anticipated.

Gate 28.8c spawns a REAL worker subprocess with the VITEST env var stripped — src/cli.ts's direct-run guard (line ~264) treats the vitest-inherited env as an import context and silently exits 0; the phase-20 execFile pattern with an explicit env copy is the house-compatible way to run the real subcommand from a test.

Code defect found and fixed during gating (gate 28.3): removePdfProgressEntry left the empty .state/pdf-progress/ cache DIR behind (non-recursive rm refuses directories on this runtime — ERR_FS_EISDIR), violating the healthy-run .state byte-identity law; now removed when provably empty (readdir check gating a safe recursive rm).

tests/phase-27.test.ts was missing the gray-matter import after the Implementer's stub-envelope edit (matter is not defined) — three phase-27 gates failed until the import was added; all 19 phase-27 tests green after.

watchItems: The .state/pdf-progress.json entry is in-run state deleted at each PDF's checkpoint — if a wiki is ever observed accumulating stale entries (crashes after the ingestion.json write but before the delete), the finalize worker may need a one-pass sweeper; watch after the first production run.

The in-flight synthesis journal must never diverge from synthesis-state.json — the journal entry is written AFTER the per-page record precisely so a crash between them degrades to a conservative re-synthesis of one page, never a skipped one.

The pre-scan resume line re-reads every chunk's extraction JSON once before the loop (N small local files; no LLM) — negligible on current PDF sizes, revisit only if chunk counts grow by orders of magnitude.
First production run after 1.0.32 should confirm the DAD_2025-class crash signature now resumes: watch for the 'Resuming <file> — N/M chunks...' line and fatalError in any new crash-log records.
